title: TimeRLM: Recursive Language Models Enable Precise Anomaly Localization in Long-Context Time-Series

claim.summary: TimeRLM accesses long signals through a Python execution environment with optional recursive model calls; AnomalyXL evaluates precise localization and supports RL post-training.

modules.name: External-context recursive Python sandbox
modules.scope_reason: External context inspection, code execution and recursive delegation do not require a temporal-specific operator.

modules.name: Long-signal anomaly localization evaluation
modules.scope_reason: Ground truth and reward score anomaly intervals, types, magnitude and channels.

modules.name: Verifiable anomaly-reward policy training
modules.scope_reason: Full-parameter GRPO updates Qwen3.5-4B using generated localization episodes.
